candidates.sourceText:
Adults
- Single visit €3.60
- 10 visits or 1 month (30 days) €29
- 4 months (120 days) €80

Weekday product (same price for everyone, no concessions)
- 6 months (182 days) €60 or 12 months (365 days) €100 (permits entry on weekdays between 11:00 and 15:00 for two hours)

Young people (15-17 years) and others (students, unemployed people, retirees, conscripts, persons undergoing non-military service, people with disabilities, those who have applied for temporary protection and those who have already received their decision)
- Single visit €2.10
- 10 visits or 1 month (30 days) €17
- 4 months (120 days) €40

War veterans, members of Lotta Svärd and informal carers (proof of eligibility required)
- Free entry

- Personal customer card (multi-visit, one-month, four-month and weekday products) €4
